_doc: Hero resolve level (0-6) and expedition difficulty. Rules: scripts/domain/resolve_system.gd. Spec: docs/01-core-systems-spec.md §6.

resolve._resist_doc: Status resistance points (%) gained per resolve level (resist_categories in statuses.json).

_difficulty_doc: level = expedition level shown to the player. Heroes above max_level refuse to go; heroes below min_level are under-leveled (start stress + extra stress taken per level short). xp = Resolve XP each survivor earns on a completed expedition. enemy_* and reward scale fights and payouts.
